notes.title: Introducing Sentinel: Stones of Disruption - The First Title Under BW Labs!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, wonderful Steam community![/h1]

We're ecstatic to announce that our roguelike shooter, Sentinel: Stones of Disruption, is the flagship title for the BW Labs initiative.

[h2]What's BW Labs?[/h2]
BW Labs is our bold endeavour aimed at empowering junior developers and the indie game community. Our vision is to be the catalyst that aids passionate creators in navigating the journey from concept to a market-ready game.

[h2]Sentinel: Stones of Disruption:[/h2]
Step into a maelstrom of relentless chaos with Sentinel: Stones of Disruption. As a state-of-the-art robotic agent, you're tasked with retrieving mystical crystals from a realm torn apart by destruction. Face unyielding adversaries in this intense rogue shooter, devising strategies to outplay and outlast on an unpredictable battlefield. Are you prepared to ascend from chaos and etch your legacy? Your journey beckons.

[h2]Steam Next Fest:[/h2]
But there's more! We warmly invite you to delve into our world firsthand. Experience our demo during the Steam Next Fest from October 9th to October 16th, 2023. Immerse yourself in the action and share your invaluable insights with us!

[h2]Community & Collaboration:[/h2]
BW Labs stands as more than just a launchpad for games. We dream of it blossoming into a collaborative hub where creators rendezvous with fans, fostering a milieu of feedback, growth, and collective innovation. As the foundation stones of BW Labs are being laid, your support and insights are invaluable!

[h2]Join Us:[/h2]
Support our vision by wishlisting Sentinel: Stones of Disruption, share your perspectives, and be part of a dynamic community striving to sculpt unparalleled gaming experiences.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357200/Sentinel_Stones_of_Disruption/

Onward to a voyage of discovery, innovation, and unparalleled gameplay!
Warm regards,
Breaking Walls
